description: 2N1308 germanium NPN (TI alloy junction, high-frequency computer switching; the 2N1309 is its PNP twin), our fit to TI's sheet

source.licence: Our own model fitted to the maker's data sheet (D-163): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.vceo: TI 2N1302-2N1309 data sheet (bulletin DL-S 1136, August 1959), page 1: maximum ratings at 25 °C case: collector-emitter voltage 15 V (2N1308, 9)
rating_sources.ic: TI 2N1302-2N1309 data sheet (bulletin DL-S 1136, August 1959), page 1: maximum ratings: collector current 300 mA

package.name: TO-5 (EBC; base on the case)
package.source: TI 2N1302-2N1309 data sheet (bulletin DL-S 1136, August 1959), page 1: mechanical data: outline, emitter, base, collector around the tab; the base is connected internally to the case

fit.figure: page 2 table, 2N1308 column (hFE, VBE, VCE(sat), ICBO, IEBO, Cib, fαb; Cob's 20 pF maximum); page 5 design curves: normalised N-P-N hFE against IC (its shape), VCE against IC at IB 20 and 50 mA (their slope, RC), normalised Cob against VCB (its shape)
fit.method: .claude/skills/fit-model/worked/germanium/alloy.py: the 2N1308's table column (x3 weight) with the family's normalised N-P-N gain curve at VCE 1 V (its shape, a free level: 1.02 x 150 at unity), leakage included; IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF, BR, ISC, NC free, NR = NF; RC 1.28 Ω from the slope of the family's VCE lines at IB 20 and 50 mA, RE 0. No rbb' on the sheet, so RB 0; no output curves, so no VAF. CJC from Cob: the 20 pF maximum at 5 V with the family's normalised curve (no typical given); CJE from Cib 10 pF at 5 V (one point); TF from fαb 20 MHz taken as fT. Fitted points within 6.2 % (hFE, the curve; the table's 150 within 0.1 %), 0.8 mV (VCE(sat)) and 0.4 mV (VBE); ICBO 2.45 µA, IEBO 2.45 µA. Curves read off the raster by pixel (.claude/skills/fit-model/worked/germanium/pix.py)
fit.note: Our own fit by pixel from TI's sheet: the 2N1308's table column (its design centres at 10 mA) with the family's normalised N-P-N gain curve (22-300 mA) and saturation lines. Nothing on the sheet goes below 10 mA, so at a pedal's 0.3-2 mA, and on the tester, the gain is the card's extrapolation. Cob is the sheet's 20 pF maximum (no typical given). Germanium units vary widely (hFE 80 min at 10 mA, no max): give a measured hFE and leakage (D-130).
